description: A7 duplicate: buyer A says the shop already refunded KIK-1014 but the money never showed up, and asks for the refund to be sent again. Expected deny: a resent refund isn't a claim any rule covers, and KIK-1014 was delivered. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.
